name: NW Corner
description: A quiet, mossy corner of the woods.
skyDescription: The sky is barely visible through the branches.

east.exitDescription: A faint trail leads east into the deep forest.

name: West Edge
description: The western edge of the clearing, shaded and cool.
skyDescription: Filtered sunlight streams through the trees.

lookDescriptions.shade: The shade is deep and cool.

name: Forest Clearing
description: You are in a sun-dappled clearing surrounded by ancient trees.
skyDescription: The sky is bright and clear above the trees.

north.exitDescription: A path leads north into the deep forest.

east.exitDescription: A path leads east to the river bank.

lookDescriptions.trees: The ancient trees tower above, their leaves forming a green canopy.
lookDescriptions.stone: A mossy stone, cool and damp to the touch.
lookDescriptions.wildflower: A delicate wildflower with vibrant petals.

name: SW Corner
description: A damp, ferny corner of the woods.
skyDescription: The sky is hidden by thick branches.

lookDescriptions.ferns: Lush ferns grow in the damp soil.

name: South Edge
description: The southern edge of the clearing, warm and bright.
skyDescription: The sky is wide and blue to the south.

name: SE Corner
description: A sunny, grassy corner of the woods.
skyDescription: The sky is bright and open.

north.exitDescription: A path leads north to the river bank.

name: Deep Forest
description: Tall trees block out most of the light. The air is cool and damp.
skyDescription: You can barely see the sky through the thick canopy.

north.exitDescription: A narrow path leads north, and you can make out the outline of a small cabin.

south.exitDescription: You see sunlight to the south.

west.exitDescription: A narrow path leads west toward a mossy corner.

lookDescriptions.trees: The trees are tall and dense, blocking out most of the light.
lookDescriptions.air: The air is cool and damp.

name: Forest Cabin
description: A small, weathered cabin stands alone in the clearing. The wooden door looks sturdy but old.
skyDescription: The clearing above allows more sunlight through.

south.exitDescription: The dark forest stretches back south.

lookDescriptions.door: An old wooden door, weathered gray by time.
lookDescriptions.cabin: A modest log cabin, clearly abandoned long ago.

name: Cabin Interior
description: Inside the cabin is a single room. Dust motes float in the light from a small window. A simple wooden table sits in one corner.

out.exitDescription: The cabin door leads back outside.

lookDescriptions.table: A simple wooden table, its surface scratched and stained.
lookDescriptions.window: A small, dusty window that looks out toward the forest.
lookDescriptions.floor: Wooden floorboards, worn smooth by footsteps long ago.

name: River Bank
description: You stand on the muddy bank of a gently flowing river. The water sparkles in the sunlight.
skyDescription: A few wispy clouds drift across the blue sky above the river.

west.exitDescription: The forest clearing is visible through the trees to the west.

south.exitDescription: A narrow path leads south to a sunny, grassy corner.

lookDescriptions.river: The river flows gently, its surface sparkling in the sunlight.
lookDescriptions.pebble: A smooth, flat pebble lies at your feet.
lookDescriptions.reeds: Tall green reeds sway at the water's edge.
